settings_mfa_totp_desc: Generates a code on every login from an app like Google Authenticator or Aegis.
settings_mfa_totp_scan_hint: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, or enter the key manually.
settings_mfa_totp_confirm_hint: Enter the code shown by your app to confirm activation.
settings_mfa_totp_disable_hint: Confirm your password to disable this method.
settings_mfa_email_desc: Get a one-time code by email on every login.
settings_mfa_recovery_hint: Use these if you lose access to your usual method. Each code works only once.
settings_mfa_recovery_low_warning: Only {count} recovery codes left, consider regenerating them.
settings_mfa_recovery_regenerate_confirm: Your current codes will be permanently invalidated and replaced with a new batch.
settings_mfa_recovery_reveal_hint: Save them somewhere safe. They won't be shown again after you leave this screen.
settings_mfa_webauthn_desc: Physical key (YubiKey) or device biometrics — resists phishing.
settings_mfa_webauthn_unsupported: Requires a secure connection (HTTPS) — unavailable on this install.
settings_mfa_webauthn_removed_passwordle: Security key removed · passwordless sign-in disabled
settings_mfa_webauthn_name_hint: Your key was just registered. Give it a name to find it easily later.
settings_mfa_webauthn_remove_hint: Confirm your password. If it's your last key, passwordless sign-in will be disabled.
settings_mfa_passwordless_desc: Sign in only with a key registered above, no password.
settings_mfa_passwordless_needs_credenti: Add a security key first to enable this.
settings_mfa_passwordless_confirm_hint: Confirm your password to change this setting.
settings_communications_timezone_desc: Used to time your episode digests.
settings_communications_push_desc: On this device. Each phone or browser is turned on separately.
settings_communications_newsletter_desc: An email for every new release, with what's new.
settings_help_body: Got an idea, found a bug, or just curious what's coming? It's all here.
settings_help_chat_body: A question or an issue? Message us directly.
settings_shortcuts_description: The keyboard shortcuts available across Loomkeep.
settings_shortcuts_overlays_close: Close the open menu or dialog
settings_support_body: Loomkeep stays free, hosted or self-hosted. If the project's been useful to you, a small gesture helps cover hosting and the time spent building it. One-time or recurring depending on the provider — account requirements vary, see the badges below.
settings_datasources_body: Loomkeep queries these catalogues live for search and detail pages; it doesn't host or edit them. Each remains subject to its own terms of use and licenses.
settings_datasources_openlibrary_notice: Book data provided by Open Library (Internet Archive) — catalogue data licensed CC0.
settings_datasources_omdb_notice: IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes and Metacritic scores provided by OMDb, under a Creative Commons BY-NC 4.0 license.
settings_datasources_igdb_notice: Video game data provided by IGDB.
settings_datasources_musicbrainz_notice: Music data provided by MusicBrainz — core data under CC0, the rest under CC BY-NC-SA 3.0.
settings_export_body: Download a full copy of your data — profile, library and watch history — as JSON.
settings_export_json_description: Download your profile, library and watch history together in a portable JSON file.
settings_export_csv_body: Or export one library as a flat CSV, to import elsewhere.
settings_export_services_body: Files ready to import as they are, no editing needed.
settings_export_reviews_hint: They will be public on the other service, even the ones you keep to your friends here. Your private notes are never exported.
settings_export_letterboxd_description: Your watched films, rewatches included, and your watchlist. Animated films are included.
settings_export_goodreads_description: All your books with their shelves and rereads. Abandoned books go on a “did-not-finish” shelf.
settings_export_letterboxd_notice: {count} files downloaded: {files}. Import the “diary” files one at a time on Letterboxd's import page, and “watchlist” from your watchlist.
settings_theme_description: Choose the color mode used across Loomkeep.
settings_language_description: Choose the language used for menus and messages.
settings_accessibility_description: Adjust Loomkeep to your reading and interaction needs on this device.
settings_accessibility_motion_descriptio: Keep the system preference or reduce non-essential animation.
settings_accessibility_contrast_descript: Increase the distinction between text, borders and surfaces.
settings_accessibility_density_descripti: Control how much information fits on screen.
settings_birthdate_description: Used to customize recommendations based on your age.
settings_adult_content_description: Include 18+ titles (hentai, adult films) in searches.
settings_spoiler_sensitivity_description: How reviews and comments tagged as spoilers are shown by default.
settings_email_already_current: That's already your current email address.
settings_password_invalid: The new password doesn't meet the requirements above.
settings_domains_description: Choose which content types appear in your app. Hidden ones disappear from navigation.
settings_domain_last_required: At least one domain must stay active.
settings_nav_style_description: Change how the sidebar and bottom bar look. "Marquee" is included; the other two are for premium members.
settings_mobile_nav_bar_description: Choose bottom-of-screen shortcuts on mobile ({min} to {max}) and their order. "Menu" always stays — it's what opens all pages.
settings_nav_max_reached: Maximum reached — remove one to add another.
settings_delete_account_description: Deleting your account permanently erases your profile and all associated data. Your reviews, comments and reports remain visible but become anonymous. This action is irreversible!
settings_delete_account_modal_descriptio: Your account, profile, and all data you own will be permanently deleted. Your reviews, comments and reports will remain visible but detached from your identity ("Deleted user"). This action can't be undone.
settings_delete_account_details_summary: See what will be deleted and anonymized
settings_sessions_description: Sessions currently open on your account. Disconnect a device you don't recognize or aren't using anymore.
settings_activity_description: Sensitive actions on your account over the last 12 months, with the device and IP address they came from.
settings_activity_empty_body: Sign-ins from a new device and security changes to your account will show up here.
settings_activity_event_mfa_recovery_cod: Signed in with a recovery code
settings_activity_event_mfa_challenge_lo: Two-factor check locked after too many tries
settings_sessions_disconnect_others_desc: All other sessions will be closed. Those devices will need to log in again.
settings_sessions_disconnect_one_descrip: This session will close. The device will need to log in again to access your account.
settings_import_description: Bring your history from another app, by category.
settings_import_history_description: Review recent imports and their outcome.
settings_import_history_empty_body: Import attempts will appear here with their result.
settings_import_goodreads_hint: (My Books → Import and export → Export Library) then drop the .csv file here. We match each book to the Open Library catalog; you choose what to import.
settings_import_babelio_hint: (My Books → Advanced features → Export my library) then drop the .csv file here. We match each book to the Open Library catalog; you choose what to import.
settings_import_babelio_limits: Babelio's export does not include reminders, tags, or loan and ownership information. Babelio can also export an abandoned book as "Read": check the suggested statuses before confirming.
settings_import_storygraph_hint: (Manage Account → Export StoryGraph Library) then drop the .csv file here. We match each book to the Open Library catalog; you choose what to import.
settings_import_trakt_hint: (Settings → Data, free — unlike creating a Trakt API app, now VIP-only), then drop the .zip file here. We analyze it to let you sort collection by collection before writing anything.
settings_import_tvtime_intro: Ask TV Time for your data ↗
settings_import_tvtime_hint: TV Time emails you a link to a .zip file: drop it here without unzipping it. We analyze it to let you sort collection by collection before writing anything.
settings_import_myanimelist_intro: Export your anime list from MyAnimeList ↗
settings_import_myanimelist_hint: Download the anime XML export, then drop it here. Titles are matched exclusively against AniList before you choose what to import.
settings_import_steam_intro: Add selected games and retrieve their Steam playtime. Steam time stays separate from sessions logged in Loomkeep. Your profile and game details must be
settings_import_steam_two_measures_body: Steam time is the value reported by Steam. Time tracked in Loomkeep is the sum of sessions you log here. A Loomkeep session may already be included in Steam time, so the two values are not added together.
settings_import_steam_preserved: A Steam update never deletes games or changes your statuses, notes, dates, or Loomkeep sessions.
settings_import_steam_hint: Find your SteamID64 with a tool like steamid.io ↗ if your profile has no custom URL.
settings_import_simkl_not_configured: Simkl import not set up on this instance (SIMKL_CLIENT_ID missing on the server).
settings_import_simkl_description: Simkl has no public profile like Trakt — we get your history (shows, movies and anime, watchlist included) directly by connecting to your account. Nothing to export or upload.
settings_privacy_public_desc: Everyone can find and follow you freely.
settings_privacy_private_desc: You approve each request; only your friends see your content.
settings_privacy_ghost_desc: Invisible: nobody can find you, follow you, or see your activity. You can follow and comment anonymously.
settings_home_layout_description: Choose your home page's widgets, where they sit and how big they are.
settings_username_taken: This username is already taken by someone else.
settings_username_check_error: Unable to check availability, try again.
settings_email_verification_desc: A verification email will be sent to the address you provide.
settings_confirmation_sent: A confirmation code has been sent to
settings_streaming_description: The platforms you have, put first in “Where to watch”.
settings_streaming_region_body: Streaming offers vary from one country to another.
settings_streaming_services_body: They come first, in colour, in “Where to watch”. You can also add them from a title's page by tapping a logo.
settings_private_profile_public_hint: A private profile cannot share publicly.
settings_privacy_description: Who can find you, and what others see about you.
settings_hide_progression_desc: Your level and XP stay visible to you only; others no longer see them on your profile, reviews, or comments.
settings_privacy_default_reviews_hint: Used when you rate a work without specifying visibility.
settings_privacy_content_hint: Your private ratings always stay private. Reviews can have an audience chosen when posting; published comments are public.
settings_privacy_ghost_description: You become invisible: unsearchable, unable to be followed, and your activity is hidden. This immediately applies the following:
settings_privacy_nothing_to_clean: Nothing to clean up yet — no immediate impact.
settings_privacy_anonymity_warning: Anonymity is not permanent: switching back to Public or Private will link your history (comments, reviews) to your real identity again.
settings_blocked_users_description: Manage people who cannot follow you or view your profile.
settings_blocked_users_empty_body: People you block from their profile will appear here.
settings_import_simkl_connected: Connected to Simkl — retrieving your history and watchlist.
settings_import_simkl_cancelled: Connection cancelled — you must authorize Loomkeep on Simkl to import your data.
settings_import_simkl_missing_code: Unable to connect to Simkl (missing code). Try again from the import page.
settings_mfa_recovery_file_generated: Generated on {date}. Each code works once.
settings_identifiers_description: What you sign in with. Every change asks for your password.
settings_empty_devices_body: This is the only session currently connected to your account.
settings_empty_security_keys_body: Add a key to use it for two-factor and passwordless sign-in.
settings_preview_datasources: TMDB, AniList, IGDB, Open Library, MusicBrainz
settings_import_none_yet: No import yet. Pick a source below.
settings_integrations_description: Everything that reads your account outside the app: API keys for your tools, subscription links for your calendar and feed reader.
settings_api_keys_info: A key grants read-only access to the resources you pick. Don't share it.
settings_api_keys_empty_body: A key lets a script or tool read your account without your password.
settings_api_keys_revoke_body: Any tool using it loses access immediately. This can't be undone.
settings_api_keys_delete_body: This key has already expired; it just disappears from the list.
settings_api_keys_access_hint: Write access will come later. Never reachable with a key: password, two-factor authentication, devices, API keys, account deletion.
settings_api_keys_never_warning: A key without an expiration stays valid until you revoke it, even when forgotten in an old script. Prefer a duration: you'll be warned before it ends.
settings_api_keys_created_warning: Copy it now: it will never be shown again.
settings_api_keys_created_mail: For your security, we just emailed you about this new key.
settings_api_keys_resource_lists_desc: Your lists and those shared with you.
settings_api_keys_resource_export_desc: All your data as JSON, for a backup.
settings_subscription_links_description: For apps that can't send a key: the address itself is the secret. Also available from the calendar and your profile.
settings_activity_event_api_key_leaked: API key found in public and revoked
settings_api_keys_recipes_hint: A ready-made key, with the access it needs.
settings_api_keys_recipe_guide: A worked example for this key
settings_api_keys_recipe_backup_desc: Fetch all your data as JSON, every night.
settings_api_keys_recipe_releases_desc: Today's episodes, for a calendar, a bot or home automation.
settings_api_keys_recipe_script_desc: Read your library, lists and stats.
settings_api_keys_limit: Limit: {count} requests per minute, across all your keys.
settings_api_keys_revoke_all_body: Every tool using one of your keys loses access immediately. This can't be undone.
settings_api_keys_expiry_mail: We'll email you 7 days before it expires.
settings_api_keys_api_disabled: The public API is turned off on this instance: your keys don't work for now.
settings_communications_releases_desc: A summary of the episodes that came out for the shows you follow.
settings_communications_push_digest_desc: Get the summary as a push notification.
settings_communications_activity_desc: The bell gets everything. Choose what's also worth a push.
settings_communications_security_note: Security alerts (sign-ins, password, API keys) always arrive by email.
settings_communications_push_off_hint: Push is off on this device: turn it on above to get these.
settings_alert_import_finished_hint: Only when the app is closed
settings_communications_description: What reaches you, and where: the bell, push and email.
